events: the complete committed outer event IDs, recipient copies first and the sender copy last
self: the sender-copy outer event ID; enables recovery through the verified account journal and the current actual key provider
queued_revision: the revision that first committed the whole batch, not a claim of relay acceptance
privacy: no inner rumor ID, room ID, plaintext preview, recipient plaintext list or private key is retained
meaning: durable complete send preparation; relay pending/accepted/refused observations remain separate facts
